global_rules.travel_buffer_note: Minimum 30 minutes must exist between any two jobs assigned to the same cleaner. Applies across all cleaners, candidates, and trainees. Hard constraint — scheduler must reject any assignment that violates this.
global_rules.day_job_window_note: Standard day-job hours. Last job must finish by 16:30. Evening and weekend jobs are tracked separately and follow different rules.
